The author of *Derech Mitzvosecha* is Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneersohn – the third Rebbe of the Chabad‑Lubavitch movement (often called the “Tzemach Tzedek”).  In writing the book, he was a **direct disciple of his father, Rabbi Sholom Dovber Schneersohn, the second Rebbe** and thus carried forward the teachings and methods of his father and, more broadly, of the Alter Rebbe, Rabbi Shneur Zalman of Liadi, the founder of the Chabad‑Lubavitch tradition.
